call_orders.applicability: First Forge-patched Chunk population after the public 2x2-neighbor router selects an eligible target Chunk.

steps.operation: Chunk.populate(IChunkProvider,IChunkGenerator) checks four possible 2x2 neighborhoods and selects an eligible Chunk
Chunk.populate(IChunkGenerator) observes that the selected Chunk is not terrain-populated and checks lighting
IChunkGenerator.populate runs generator-owned structures and decoration
GameRegistry.generateWorld runs registered IWorldGenerator instances
Chunk is marked dirty after generator-owned population and every registered IWorldGenerator return

call_orders.applicability: An eligible Chunk which is already terrain-populated.

steps.operation: Chunk.populate(IChunkGenerator) selects the already-terrain-populated branch
IChunkGenerator.generateStructures performs any deferred structure maintenance
Chunk is marked dirty only when generateStructures returns true; GameRegistry.generateWorld is not called

call_orders.applicability: Every event posted through a Forge EventBus.

steps.operation: EventBus.post resolves the listener array for its bus id
EventBus.post invokes each listener in array order
EventBus.post returns the event cancellation state after all permitted listeners
GameRegistry computes the ascending-weight generator list when its cache is absent
GameRegistry resets the Forge Random to the same chunk seed before each registered generator
Each IWorldGenerator.generate callback runs in sorted order; a thrown exception prevents later callbacks

call_orders.applicability: A persisted Anvil chunk completed on the synchronous ChunkIOProvider callback.

steps.operation: ChunkDataEvent.Load exposes the persisted NBT on the synchronous callback
IChunkGenerator.recreateStructures restores generator structure bookkeeping
Chunk.onLoad posts ChunkEvent.Load after the chunk enters the provider map
The public Chunk population router evaluates neighbor readiness

call_orders.applicability: Server-side chunk request which misses both loaded and persisted chunks.

steps.operation: ChunkProviderServer.provideChunk resolves or requests the chunk
The selected IChunkGenerator creates the base Chunk
Chunk writes and ChunkPrimer writes occur inside the generator's implementation
ChunkProviderServer inserts the returned Chunk into its loaded map
Chunk.onLoad posts ChunkEvent.Load for the newly generated Chunk
The public Chunk population router evaluates neighbor readiness
